lines.en: I bumped into Joanna on the street yesterday.
Wow, that must have been awkward.
Well, no, actually, she asked me if I wanted to get a drink.
You, uh, didn't say yes to that, did you?
Last time you went out with her, you said she was a big, dull dud.
Well, I think I judged her too quickly.
And this time, we were able to take the relationship to the next level.
Well, last time, I almost got fired.
You must end it. You must end it now.
Oh, come on. It's not like this is an everyday occurrence for me.
I mean, usually, I'm pretty much just in there by myself.
God, would you just calm down?
I'm gonna say this for the last time.
- -We'll buy and wrap all of your Christmas gifts!
I'll squeeze you fresh orange juice every morning!
There's gonna be rumors about this.
There's no way to stop it.
How do Monica and Phoebe know?
And when they ask me what I saw,
I can make you a legend.
I can make you this generation's Milton Berle.
